title: A stack locally quasi-finite over a field is a disjoint union of points with finite automorphism groups
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack locally quasi-finite over a field is a disjoint union of points each with finite automorphism group (author lemma at source lines 5001-5007, label lemma-locally-quasi-finite-over-field). The proof (source lines 5009-5034) applies the discreteness characterization of local quasi-finiteness, presents the stack by a smooth cover and reads off the finite automorphism groups from the points of that cover (proof lines 5009-5033). The reduction to the presentation and the finiteness of the automorphism groups are the substance. H3.
